sentences.text:
: 
G.A. 
 Court No. - 10
 Hon'Ble Rajnish Kumar, J. 
Hon'Ble Zafeer Ahmad, J. .
1.
None appears on behalf of the petitioner.
2.There is no request for adjournment or pass over the case.
3. This petition has been filed with the following prayers.

(i) to issue, a writ, order or direction in the nature MANDAMUS directing the opposite party no.2 &
3 to ensure free, fair, proper, impartial and speedy investigation of FIR No. 139/2024, Under Section 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 504, 506, 352 I.P.C., Police Station- Bhinga, District- Shrawasti.
(ii) to issue, a writ, order or direction in the nature of MANDAMUS directing the opposite party no.2 to transfer the investigation of FIR No. 139/2024, Under Section 419, 420 467, 468, 471, 504, 506,
352 LP.C., Police Station- Bhinga District- Shrawasti to any other Police Station of Distr Shrawasti.
4.

Learned A.G.A., on the basis of instructions dated 14.10.2024 received from Sri Yogendra Babu,
Sub Inspector, Police Station Kotwali Bhinga, District Shrawasti, submits that final report bearing no. B0084/2024 dated 03.10.2024 has been forwarded to the court, therefore, this petition has lost its efficacy and has rendered infructuous.
The said instructions are taken on record.
Shahnaz  Nankau vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ...
